shared_elements: low relief carving on a flat stone surface
horizontal register bands dividing the composition
repeated small motifs in a row (band of repeated shapes)
animals/creatures in profile (A) vs no animals in B — only shared as relief figures
circular/disc-like element (A's small disc held by figure; B's large wheel)
justification: Both are low-relief carved surfaces organised into horizontal registers with a band of repeated small motifs, and both contain a round disc-like form, but these are generic compositional devices. A depicts animals and quadrupeds in profile with a snake-like creature below, while B depicts a large multi-spoked wheel of a vehicle with woven/patterned bodywork and a petal border — entirely different subject matter and no shared specific motifs or relationships.
